remarks: Welcome to Your Dream Townhome!  This fabulous residence offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in a modern, casual setting. Located in a quiet and immaculate, PET-FRIENDLY complex, you'll enjoy easy access to shops, restaurants, and highways.  Step inside to discover a spacious open living and dining area, complete with a cozy fireplace-ideal for gatherings and relaxation. The large eat-in kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with stainless steel appliances, tons of storage and space to whip up your favorite meals.  The townhome features two generously sized bedrooms with large closets and 1.5 baths, providing ample space for you and your guests. The upstairs oversized bathroom offers both a tub and a separate standing shower. Hardwood floors run throughout the space, adding a touch of elegance and ease of maintenance. For added convenience, a washer and dryer are located on the second floor, making laundry day a breeze.   Enjoy the outdoors on your private deck, perfect for morning coffees or evening cocktails. The basement provides additional storage space, ensuring you have plenty of room for all your belongings. Parking is never a hassle, with spaces available for you and your visitors.  Experience modern living with all the comforts and amenities you desire in a vibrant community. This home is more than just a place to live-it's a lifestyle. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity!
